title: Search score ranges
issue_title: SearchHit.score range for cosine, IP, and L2
change_summary: Document the real SearchHit.score range for each distance metric. Cosine is cosine similarity from -1 to 1, inner product is an unbounded dot product, and L2 is 1 / (1 + distance) in (0, 1].
bindings_note: Comments only in the README, the public SearchHit note, Node types, and Node JSDoc. No scoring change.
tagline: Embedded vector DB for AI agents and RAG
release_tagline: Score ranges now match the distance metric you picked

highlights.name: DIST_COSINE
highlights.desc: Score is cosine similarity, from -1 to 1. It is not forced into 0 to 1.

highlights.name: DIST_IP
highlights.desc: Score is the raw dot product. It can be negative or greater than 1.

highlights.name: DIST_L2
highlights.desc: Score is 1 / (1 + distance). Closer vectors score higher, between 0 and 1.

install: pip install logosdb   ·   npm i logosdb
